one_line: Open on the finished set under a text that ends with a colon, then rebuild it item by item.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down: a wooden desk with a pen cup, a rose-gold tape dispenser, pencils and a chalkboard heart. No speech. Grey box mid-frame: "כשאמרו לך, תיצרי סביבה אסתטית ונקייה ותהיה פרודוקטיבית יותר. הסביבה:". 0:02 a hand stacks the items.
q1_hook.why: A line the viewer has heard, ending on a colon, sets up a reveal, and the finished desk fills the first frame as a visual teaser (H5, H2, T3). The text sits mid-frame over the items (T2), there is no voice (H4), and the claim is about mood, not what the products do.

beats.what: The finished desk under the text; a hand stacks the items into a pile
A pink ARTIS pen cup; pastel highlighters and rose-gold scissors unboxed and put in
beats.why: The first items, each a quick unwrap

beats.what: A pen pack held up and added; a pink protractor and ruler set in a case
A clear rose-gold stapler opened to show its spring; a hole punch in its box
beats.why: A mechanism to look at, not just a colour

beats.what: A clear tape dispenser and a wire tape holder are assembled in hands
beats.why: The longest single product, with a visible action

beats.what: A pink pencil box, a mechanical pencil, an 18-pencil box slid open
beats.why: Another unboxing, more of the same

beats.what: A teal file holder; spiral notebooks flipped; a clipboard; a small notebook
beats.why: Fifteen seconds of pages flipped, the slowest stretch

beats.what: A chalkboard unwrapped; a heart is drawn in chalk
beats.why: The only item actually used, and the heart from 0:00

beats.what: The finished desk, then close-ups of the file holder and the chalk heart

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: none. The caption, "וואלה, עושה חשק לעבוד !", states a feeling and asks nothing.
q2_flow.why: A teaser, a reset, then one item every 5 to 7 s with a new picture every second or so keeps hands and colour moving (E2, R3), and the last frames echo the first (R4). At 65 s one repeated unbox-and-place pattern runs long, and the notebook flipping at 0:39-0:53 adds little (R1, R2).

q3_cta.what: None. No ask on screen or in the caption. The caption's second line credits the brand: "כל המוצרים של artis, מבית פלפוט !". No link, shop or price.
q3_cta.why: A viewer who wants the set cannot tell where to buy it, and nothing asks them to comment, send or save (against C6). A brand credit is not an action. The calm, tidy feeling is its own pull for a send to a friend (R5).

q4_shown.what: A pastel and rose-gold desk set unboxed by hands only: pen cup, highlighters, scissors, pens, protractor set, stapler, hole punch, tape dispenser, pencils, file holder, notebooks, clipboard, chalkboard. The ARTIS logo shows on most items. No price, no use but a chalk heart.
q4_shown.why: Product in hand from 0:02 and a visible finished set (S1, S4), with a colour palette as the benefit. But the brand logo is on screen for most of the Reel, far above a quarter (against C7, H3), and no item is shown being used, so nothing is proved (K5).

q5_edit.what: About 40 shots in 65 s (first-pass count, about 1.6 s each), straight cuts on hand motion, some motion blur. One desk location. One text box 0:00-0:04, none after. No speech. Ends on close-ups of the file holder and the chalk heart.
q5_edit.why: Fast cuts inside one scene keep a satisfying unboxing rhythm (E2, R3). With no text after 0:04, nothing names an item or says what it does, and no audible message is established (against T1, E4). It ends with no closing line (E8).

q6_topic.what: An unboxing and arrangement of a matching desk stationery range; the need is an attractive, tidy workspace. It is aimed at adults, not parents of young children.
q6_topic.why: The hook line is a relatable moment (K3), and the calm, satisfying colour and tidy order give a positive but low-arousal feeling (K1). There is no story, character or parent need, so it does not carry over to LumeBook's audience (K2, K6).

q7_filmed.what: A top-down static start; then handheld medium shots of hands against a monitor and a white wall in daylight, items held up to the lens; the finished desk in a wide shot; handheld close-ups at the end. One adult's hands; no face, no child.
q7_filmed.why: Hands holding each item to the lens put the packaging and colour in the viewer's view (F5, F4), and daylight on pastel colours is clean (F7). The busy monitor and arm behind the hands are a distraction. A native desk setting looks homemade (H8).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00-0:04 one grey rounded box, white bold type, two lines, about 45 to 56 percent down: "כשאמרו לך, תיצרי סביבה אסתטית ונקייה ותהיה פרודוקטיבית יותר. הסביבה:". No text after about 0:04: no labels, subtitles or names. The ARTIS logo and Hebrew product names on the packaging show in the frames.
q8_text.caption: "וואלה, עושה חשק לעבוד !". 12 words in 2 lines: a feeling, then "כל המוצרים של artis, מבית פלפוט !". No hashtags, no ask, no disclosure word; Palphot is the coauthor.
q8_text.why: The first card is a short promise, readable, inside the safe zone but over the picture (T3, T2, T4). It is up 4 s for about 70 characters, which is borderline (T5). The caption has no product keywords and no hashtags (T7), and a brand credit is not a disclosure (T8).

weak_points: 65 s of one unboxing pattern; no text after 0:04; the brand logo on most frames; no item used; no price or where to buy; no ask; a disclosure only by coauthor tag.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the finished book first under a colon text, then hands unboxing it on one clean surface, ending on a shelf. Under 20 s.
not_verified: Whether Palphot paid or only supplied the items; music (the transcript is only "תודה רבה", so there is no speech); who the creator is; exact product names and prices. Corrections: the text box ends at about 0:04, not 5 s; the last 6 s are three close-ups (0:59 wide shot, then the file holder and the chalk heart), not one push-in; the reset at 0:02 undoes the finished desk.
